issues.t: Turbocharger oil leak, smoke or failure
issues.sym: White or blue smoke from the exhaust, a check engine light (often code P0106), oil in the intake piping, or a loss of power.
issues.why: The bearings inside one or both turbochargers on the 3.0L twin-turbo V6 can wear early and let engine oil leak through into the intake and exhaust. Infiniti has a service procedure for turbo replacement on this engine.
issues.next: Have it checked soon; a failing turbo can damage the engine. On 2016-2018 cars Infiniti extended turbo coverage to 10 years or 120,000 miles, so ask the dealer before paying.

issues.t: Driveshaft can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or vibration from under the car, a sudden loss of drive power, or the car rolling while in Park.
issues.why: On rear-wheel-drive Q50s the driveshaft can crack from metal fatigue and break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the open recall and book it. If you hear a new clunk underneath, use the parking brake when parked and get it towed in.

issues.t: Steer-by-wire may act up at startup (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel can be off-center or the car responds more or less than expected to steering inputs right after starting.
issues.why: On cars with Direct Adaptive Steering (the electronic steer-by-wire system), a software error at startup can change how much the wheels turn for a given steering input.
issues.next: Make sure the recall software update has been done. If steering ever feels wrong, stop and restart the car and have it checked.

issues.t: Steering may fail in freezing weather (recall)
issues.sym: A steering warning light and suddenly heavy or delayed steering when starting the car in freezing temperatures.
issues.why: In very cold engine-bay temperatures, the steer-by-wire software could shut the electric steering off and be slow to switch to the mechanical backup.
issues.next: Check that the recall reprogramming was done. This is a serious safety recall.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag 'off' light comes on even though an adult is in the seat.
issues.why: The passenger seat sensor system can mistake an adult for a child or an empty seat and turn the front passenger airbag off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers replace the occupant classification control unit or update its software for free.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator may crack (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs before a crash.
issues.why: Some driver airbag inflators were not welded properly and could crack when the airbag deploys.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall; the dealer replaces the inflator free.

issues.t: Engine may stall from fuel pump software (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or loses power, sometimes while driving.
issues.why: On 2.0L turbo models the fuel pump control software could send too little fuel to the engine.
issues.next: Check for the recall. The dealer reprograms the fuel pump control module free.

issues.t: Engine may cut power after hard acceleration (recall)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly loses power or stalls after you accelerate quickly.
issues.why: The engine computer could wrongly detect a problem during rapid acceleration and cut fuel and power.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall; the dealer reprograms the engine computer free.

issues.t: Steering knuckle or rear axle housing may be weak (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning; a cracked part can cause a clunk, poor handling or a wheel problem.
issues.why: Some front steering knuckles or rear axle housings were not heat-treated correctly and may not be strong enough.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the parts inspected or replaced free.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: No rear camera picture on the screen when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Camera display settings could be changed in a way that stops the rearview image from showing.
issues.next: Check for the recall. The dealer updates the software for free.

issues.t: Backup camera screen goes blank (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software error could stop the display from showing the rearview camera image.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall; the dealer updates the software free.

issues.t: Oil gallery gasket failure
issues.sym: The low oil pressure light flickers at idle, timing chain rattle, or a check engine light for valve timing.
issues.why: On the 3.7L V6 a rubber gasket on an oil passage behind the timing cover can split and lose oil pressure inside the engine.
issues.next: Stop and check the oil if the light flickers. Replacing the gasket means removing the timing cover, so fix it before engine damage.

issues.t: Brake vibration and fast brake wear
issues.sym: The steering wheel or brake pedal shakes when braking, and pads and rotors wear out much sooner than expected.
issues.why: Owners of early Q50s report warped front rotors at around 30,000 miles and brakes worn out as early as 12,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the rotors measured. Quality replacement rotors and pads usually cure the shake.

issues.t: Fast or uneven tire wear
issues.sym: Tires wear out early, often on the inside edges, sometimes by 12,000 miles.
issues.why: Owners report early tire wear on the Q50, linked to the alignment settings and soft performance tires.
issues.next: Have the alignment checked and rotate tires regularly. Look at the inner edges when the car is on a lift.

issues.t: Transmission control module failure
issues.sym: Harsh or no shifting, the car stuck in one gear, or a transmission warning light.
issues.why: The electronic transmission control unit can fail. Owners say it is hard to diagnose and the part can take time to get.
issues.next: Have the transmission codes read by a shop with Infiniti software. Ask the dealer about any extended coverage.

issues.t: Drive belt slips off the pulley
issues.sym: A squealing belt, many warning lights at once, no A/C or heat, or the engine overheating.
issues.why: On early 3.0L twin-turbo cars the engine drive belt can walk off its pulley. Infiniti issued a service bulletin for it.
issues.next: Pull over safely if warning lights appear and the temperature rises; the belt also drives the water pump. Ask the dealer about the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires, hesitation and slowly fading power, usually after 80,000 miles.
issues.why: This engine sprays fuel straight into the cylinders, so no fuel washes the intake valves. Oil vapor bakes onto them as hard carbon over time.
issues.next: If you have a rough idle with no other cause, ask a shop to scope the intake valves. Walnut-shell blasting cleans them.

issues.t: Misfire from a failing fuel injector
issues.sym: A check engine light with misfire codes (P0301 to P0306), rough idle and weak acceleration.
issues.why: Metal debris from the factory fuel rail can damage injectors. Infiniti issued a bulletin and an updated fuel rail.
issues.next: Have the misfiring cylinder found. Ask the dealer whether the fuel rail bulletin applies, since replacing injectors alone may not fix it.

issues.t: Emergency braking warning light comes on
issues.sym: A warning light and messages for automatic emergency braking or forward collision warning, and the system switches itself off.
issues.why: Infiniti issued service bulletins for this warning, often caused by the front radar or camera, its aim, or software.
issues.next: Clean the front sensor and windshield camera area. If it keeps happening, the dealer can check the bulletin and recalibrate the system.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
issues.sym: The fuel gauge shows the wrong level, drops quickly or doesn't match the distance-to-empty, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: Infiniti issued a bulletin for an inaccurate fuel gauge with stored engine codes, linked to the fuel level sensors.
issues.next: Track miles per fill-up so you don't run dry, and ask the dealer to check the bulletin.

issues.t: Emergency call (SOS) system fault
issues.sym: A warning about the SOS or telematics system, or the emergency call button doesn't work.
issues.why: Infiniti issued a bulletin for a stored fault code in the telematics unit that runs automatic emergency calls.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the bulletin. The car drives normally, but crash calls may not work until it is fixed.

issues.t: Key not detected and car won't start
issues.sym: A 'key not detected' message and the engine won't start, even with the key in the car.
issues.why: Infiniti issued bulletins for intelligent key detection faults and failed key setups.
issues.next: Try holding the key fob against the start button. Replace the fob battery, then have the dealer check the bulletin.

issues.t: Check engine light for an EVAP leak
issues.sym: Check engine light with codes P0442, P0455 or P0456. The car drives normally.
issues.why: A small fuel vapor leak. Infiniti issued a bulletin about a leaking O-ring at the EVAP vent control valve.
issues.next: Tighten the gas cap first. If the light returns, have the EVAP system smoke-tested.

issues.t: Check engine light from an oil pressure control wiring fault
issues.sym: A check engine light with code P06DA (engine oil pressure control).
issues.why: Infiniti issued a bulletin saying a damaged engine room wiring harness section can cause this code.
issues.next: Have the code read. The bulletin repair replaces the harness section rather than engine parts.

issues.t: Coolant leak at the water pump
issues.sym: Dried pink or white coolant crust near the water pump, a sweet smell, or the coolant level dropping.
issues.why: Infiniti issued a bulletin about coolant residue at the water pump.
issues.next: Check the coolant level often. Have the pump inspected; replace it if it is actively leaking.

issues.t: Front bumper paint peeling
issues.sym: Paint flakes or peels off the front bumper cover.
issues.why: This is the most-reported Q50 problem on RepairPal. The paint does not bond well to the plastic bumper cover.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about paint warranty coverage if the car is newer. Otherwise a body shop can refinish the bumper.

issues.t: Rear shock absorbers wear out early
issues.sym: A bouncy or floaty rear end, a knock over bumps, or oil on the rear shocks.
issues.why: Early rear shock replacement is one of the most-reported Q50 problems on RepairPal.
issues.next: Have the shocks checked for leaks and replace them in pairs.
